excluded_candidates.reason: B=integral_D phi dA satisfies turning identity; Euclidean E does not. Explicit three-centre m10 parabola violates Euclidean reading. Weighted convention supplies natural repair, so no unconditional theorem refutation.
Verified false upper coefficient comparison: a~2r/k unbounded for m0. Need weighted existence/asymptotic proof or precise Su20 hypothesis match; no demonstrated nonexistence.

LLS21 exactness/area-ratio/angle/transverse two-plane blow-down hypotheses require matching. Base dilation lambda is ambient sqrt(lambda), with standard time lambda^-1; source(4.8) uses lambda^-2, useful possibly for static spatial limits but not by itself parabolic tangent flow. Arbitrary-time record-minimum selection also needs justification.
LSS22 Theorem1.2 actually gives restart from immersed C1 limit under stated tangent hypotheses. Relevant pages obtained, parsed, read and viewed.

Uniform sets alone insufficient but almost-calibrated graph supplies extra control. O(epsilon) swept volume stronger than needed; energy/Cauchy–Schwarz gives convergence to0. Full package not recertified.
